capabilities: start timed writing sessions with a countdown
delete the note's text when typing pauses past the fuse limit
configure countdown duration, fuse time, font size and background color
track successful completed sessions with a counter
extras: The README warns the plugin deletes text in the note and is provided as-is with no warranty, so bugs could cause unexpected deletions; users are pointed to the forum thread for feedback and support.
motivation: The author had been a paying FlowState customer since 2016 and wanted something similar for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to force continuous, distraction-free drafting, so writers can stall, edit or procrastinate instead of producing a first draft.
summary: Freewriting enforcer that deletes the text written in the current note if you pause for longer than a configurable fuse during a timed session.
